mapper.insert: insert into venue_comment (venue_id, user_id, content, like_count) values (#{venueId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{likeCount})
mapper.select: select c.id, u.display_name as author_name, c.content, c.like_count, c.created_at from venue_comment c join user_account u on u.id = c.user_id where c.venue_id = #{venueId} order by c.like_count desc, c.id desc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into venue_comment_like (comment_id, user_id) values (#{commentId}, #{userId})
mapper.update: update venue_comment set like_count = like_count - 1 where id = #{commentId} and like_count > 0
